s1: Our dashboard says sales crashed fifty-five percent. Every Monday, a marketing team in Taiwan has to explain numbers like this, and decide what to do next.
s2: Meet Ace, our Gemini agent. It plans, then runs a tool loop through the Interactions API, querying the sales data like-for-like and showing every step.
s3: The verdict: it's a half-year artifact. Like-for-like, sales are up five percent, and every number links back to its source row.
s4: Now the market. Gemini with Google Search grounding scans Dcard, PTT, YouTube and Facebook: Coke Zero versus Pepsi Zero and Sprite Zero. Share of voice, sentiment, and what people actually talk about.
s5: Ace turns that buzz and live momo prices into one cited marketing brief, and Gradium reads it out loud.
s6: Ace only proposes. I approve, and then it acts.
s7: Need a counter-campaign? Ace drafts the visual with Nano Banana, but only after I say yes.
s8: CokeZerope Marketing. Built today with the Gemini Interactions API, Google Search grounding, Deep Research, Gradium voice, and Entire. Agents that check, cite, and ask before they act.
